I did not add 'Depends on: M1-T02' to M1-T03, because an edge between two interface tasks is banned. I also did not move the fake to M1-T27: M1-T26 uses the API fake and comes before M1-T27, so the move would need an edge to a later task. The fake stays in M1-T03.

Partly skipped. I added the delegation invariant, the M1-T12 acceptance and the Read-line types. I did not make M1-T13–M1-T15 depend on M1-T12. They build against the PitReader replay double frozen by M1-T01, and M1-T12 delegates to the M1-T01 stubs, so no real input needs that edge.

Small deviation from the fix. commit_version keeps VersionedStore next to StagedRun ('VersionedStore, StagedRun, Bars, Actions, Company → DataVersion'), because VersionedStore.commit is a method on the store and can't be called from a StagedRun alone. Lint needed a type for StagedRun in the step tables, so I added a store.StagedRun type section. The inline comment on VersionedStore.begin moved into it.
Took the narrower option. I added a nullable total_return column to query.Bars instead of a new query.Universe symbol. M1-T01 and M1-T14 already read query.Bars, so no Read line changed.
